escalations.title: vitest — Arbitrary File Read & Remote Code Execution
escalations.exploit_scenario: Unauthenticated attacker with network access to Vitest UI server reads arbitrary files via path traversal in mock redirect API, then executes arbitrary code on the developer/CI machine.
escalations.impact: Full filesystem read + code execution on dev/CI environment
escalations.fix: cd Source/Frontend && npm update vitest  # target >=5.1.0

escalations.title: proxy-addr — IPv4-Mapped IPv6 IP Spoofing (via Express)
escalations.exploit_scenario: Attacker sends request with X-Forwarded-For: ::ffff:127.0.0.1; Express resolves req.ip as 127.0.0.1 — bypassing any IP-based access control or rate-limiting logic. Backend has NO authentication layer per inspector.config.yml, amplifying exposure.
escalations.impact: IP-based access controls fully defeated; request spoofing possible
escalations.fix: cd Source/Backend && npm update express  # pulls proxy-addr >=2.0.8

escalations.title: @vitest/mocker — Path Traversal & Arbitrary File Read
escalations.exploit_scenario: Stacked with DEP-001: attacker uses @vitest/mocker mock redirect API to traverse to files outside project root; exfiltrates .env, secrets, SSH keys from CI runner.
escalations.impact: Sensitive file exfiltration from CI/dev environment
escalations.fix: cd Source/Frontend && npm update vitest  # resolves all vitest-related CVEs

escalations.title: @vitest/mocker — Unauthenticated Code Injection via Manual Mock Registration
escalations.exploit_scenario: Attacker with access to test environment injects arbitrary code via manual mock registration; combined with DEP-001 network access, achieves full code execution without authentication.
escalations.impact: Arbitrary code execution in test/dev environment
escalations.fix: cd Source/Frontend && npm update vitest  # target >=5.1.0

p1_findings.title: Routes bypass service layer — direct store access in 3 route files
p1_findings.exploit_scenario: Business logic executed directly in route handlers; store state can be modified without going through service-layer validation, enabling state machine inconsistencies and business rule bypass.
p1_findings.recommendation: Create workItemService.ts; route handlers call services; services call store. Remove direct store imports from all route files.

p1_findings.title: Traceability enforcer does not cover Specifications/ — false-green gate
p1_findings.exploit_scenario: CI gate reports PASSED while 95 domain requirements have zero implementation coverage. False green obscures total spec drift; teams ship unvalidated code believing quality gates are satisfied.
p1_findings.recommendation: Extend enforcer to scan Specifications/ for FR-\d+ and FR-TMP-\d+; or document the two-tier traceability model and update CLAUDE.md.

p1_findings.title: 95 Specifications/ requirements entirely unimplemented — 0% coverage
p1_findings.exploit_scenario: CLAUDE.md mandates specs-first development. The authoritative domain specs describe features (SQLite, AI voting, human approval, pipeline runner) that are entirely absent from Source/. The gap between documented intent and reality is total — product, audit, and compliance decisions based on specs will be incorrect.
p1_findings.recommendation: Product decision required: (a) retro-spec workflow engine into Specifications/ and deprecate unbuilt FRs, OR (b) scope incremental implementation plan for FR-001…FR-069.

p2_findings.title: Duplicate logger modules — two valid import paths
p2_findings.recommendation: Add default export to utils/logger.ts; delete src/logger.ts; update all imports.

p2_findings.title: eslint-disable suppresses exhaustive-deps without justification (2 files)
p2_findings.recommendation: Add inline comment justifying each suppression, or refactor to satisfy the lint rule.

p2_findings.title: body-parser — DoS via Trailing Bytes After Compression
brace-expansion — DoS via Exponential Expansion
p2_findings.recommendation: Update build toolchain packages in next maintenance window.

p2_findings.title: uuid — Missing Buffer Bounds Check (potential OOB write)
p2_findings.recommendation: cd Source/Backend && npm update uuid  # target >=11.1.1

p2_findings.title: vite — Multiple File Access Bypass Vulnerabilities (3 CVEs)
p2_findings.recommendation: npm update vite  # target >=8.3.6 (major version bump — audit breaking changes)

p2_findings.title: react-router-dom / @remix-run/router — Open Redirect
p2_findings.recommendation: npm update react-router-dom to latest 6.x or upgrade to v7

p2_findings.title: Additional high-severity transitive CVEs (2 remaining)
p2_findings.recommendation: Run npm audit in both workspaces and apply npm audit fix for all auto-fixable items.

p3_findings.title: 3 files approaching 500-line split threshold
p3_findings.recommendation: Flag for extraction on next edit: custom hooks from pages; sub-routers from workflow.ts.

p3_findings.title: vite.config.ts recently modified, lacks Verifies traceability comment
p3_findings.recommendation: Add // Verifies: FR-WF-009 (or appropriate FR-WF ID) at top of file.

p3_findings.title: 7 moderate-severity CVEs in transitive dependencies
p3_findings.recommendation: Address during routine maintenance window; run npm audit fix.
